boundaries: Uses the actual production standalone BFF, verified TLS, private Valkey and real Chromium returns.
Provider protocol belongs to the source-pinned server fixture; candidate activation is fixture-driven here.
Does not establish React login/admin UI acceptance (#197/#198) or native real GitHub acceptance (server #581).
The reported production checks use the retained qualified Linux ARM64 server image; CI separately qualifies its AMD64 production image.
Legacy pinned v0.0.22 compatibility remains the declared release target.
limitations: Accepted login handoffs can redeliver the same opaque cookie for five minutes; ordinary sessions retain normal expiry/revocation.
Abandoned-claim cleanup requires the original configured backend and Valkey within its bounded retention window.
Uncertain protected mutation results require inspection before a new approval; no automatic replay.
Candidate ownership includes its initiating credential; rotation/expiry requires recreating and retesting.
